revision: rev2 after PR #131 review (2xP1 + 1xP2): simulated-emit verdicts downgraded, rewrite runId bug fixed, falsy-result omission semantics recorded
gate_rule: C2 Gate PASS requires every criterion deterministically satisfied; any undetermined/partial/no keeps the gate FAIL and C2 stays NOT_SUPPORTED (C1 remains PASS). No time-proximity/tool-name/argument-similarity linkage guessing is permitted.

evidence_layers.static_sdk_source: pinned openclaw@2026.6.6 d.ts declarations and dist bundle source of the host dispatch/emit path
evidence_layers.in_process_harness: drives the real SDK hook runner through the public plugin-sdk/plugin-runtime surface (test/after-tool-call-spike.test.mjs)
evidence_layers.in_process_host_path: drives the real host-side execution chain exported by plugin-sdk/agent-harness (wrapToolWithBeforeToolCallHook, runBeforeToolCallHook) and the real emit helper runAgentHarnessAfterToolCallHook
evidence_layers.simulated_host_emit: the probe itself decides when the emit helper fires; proves event payload shape IF the host emits, but NOT that/when the real run-attempt observer emits or its ordering (observer is not exported on any public plugin-sdk surface; the agent tool loop needs a live model turn)
evidence_layers.constructed_sequence: ordering was arranged by the probe, not observed from the host; static-only conclusion
evidence_layers.not_applicable: no probe applies within the spike scope

live_gateway_deviation: An isolated live Gateway cannot deterministically answer the spike questions: POST /tools/invoke runs runBeforeToolCallHook but never emits after_tool_call, and the agent harness tool loop that emits after observations requires a live model turn. The real run-attempt observer (emitAfterToolCallObservation) is not exported on any public plugin-sdk surface, so host scheduling questions (Q6/Q9/Q10) stay undetermined in this revision instead of being simulated into a PASS.
review_findings_fixed: P1 host emitter: scenarios that manually invoked the emit helper are now labeled simulated_host_emit / constructed_sequence and their verdicts downgraded; no PASS verdict depends on probe-scheduled emission

P1 rewrite runId: scenario D now passes the same runId to the wrapper ctx and the emit helper, so recordAdjustedParamsForToolCall/consumeAdjustedParamsForToolCall hit the same key; the after event now observably carries the adjusted params through the real record/consume channel

P2 falsy results: scenario F records that successful false/0/empty-string/null results emit an after event with NEITHER result NOR error; terminal mapping must not classify success/failure from field presence

questions.question: after_tool_call exists on the pinned OpenClaw SDK/runtime
questions.evidence_ref: PLUGIN_HOOK_NAMES includes after_tool_call; hook-types d.ts declares (event: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent, ctx: PluginHookToolContext) => Promise<void> | void; harness registers and drives the real runner

questions.question: actual TypeScript type/fields of the handler input
questions.evidence_ref: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent = { toolName: string; params: Record<string, unknown>; runId?: string; toolCallId?: string; result?: unknown; error?: string; durationMs?: number }; PluginHookToolContext = { agentId?; sessionKey?; sessionId?; runId?; trace?; toolName; toolKind?; toolInputKind?; toolCallId?; getSessionExtension?; channelId? }; harness confirms verbatim pass-through

questions.question: event.toolCallId / ctx.toolCallId are provided stably
questions.evidence_ref: the real wrapper and emit helper propagate the same caller-supplied toolCallId on event and ctx in every scenario; both tool execution entry points (wrapped agent tool, /tools/invoke) generate and propagate toolCallId. Host-side presence across all real tool kinds still relies on the emit path being reached (see Q6/Q9)

questions.question: toolCallId identical between before_tool_call and after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: before handler, real execute, and after handler observed the identical toolCallId in every scenario; the emit path derives after toolCallId from the same harness item.id

questions.question: result shape on the success path
questions.evidence_ref: truthy success results pass through unchanged (scenario allow_success). BUT the emit helper includes result via a truthiness check: scenario falsy_success_results proves successful false/0/empty-string/null produce an after event with NEITHER result NOR error. Presence of result/error must never classify success/failure

questions.question: error/throw path still triggers after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: tool_failure scenario proves payload shape IF emission happens (bounded string error, no result) and that the host propagates the error, but the emission itself was scheduled by the probe; whether the real run-attempt observer emits for error items is static evidence only (emitAfterToolCallObservation fires for non-running items with itemToolError) and needs live confirmation

questions.question: error field and duration field semantics
questions.evidence_ref: error is a bounded string when emitted; durationMs is computed from startedAt when the emit params carry it, undefined otherwise. Field population on the real observer path (which items carry startedAt/durationMs) remains static-only

questions.question: before_tool_call handler completion happens-before tool invocation
questions.evidence_ref: wrapToolWithBeforeToolCallHook awaits runBeforeToolCallHook before calling the real execute (real wrapper code, not simulated); scenario allow_success observed before_tool_call -> tool_executed

questions.question: blocked (block:true) calls still trigger after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: REVISED: the solid C1 fact stands — block:true short-circuits execution with invocation_count=0 and the wrapped tool returns the host blocked result. Whether the real observer then emits after_tool_call for that blocked item could only be simulated by the probe; the run-attempt observer is not exported, so emission-on-blocked stays undetermined until live evidence. PR-RTE-03 must treat both branches safely: never derive terminal execution facts for blocked gate states regardless of after-hook arrival

questions.question: ordering of after_tool_call relative to tool_result_persist
questions.evidence_ref: REVISED: the probe constructed the persist -> after sequence itself. Static evidence (after observation scheduled via setImmediate; tool_result_persist synchronous on the transcript hot path) suggests persist-first, but observed ordering from the real host is missing

questions.question: runtime behavior when an after_tool_call handler throws
questions.evidence_ref: runVoidHook catches per-handler errors under the fail-open policy (logs, does not rethrow) and sibling handlers still run; the hook-helpers wrapper additionally try/catches with a warn log; harness test proves containment with no mutation of tool facts

questions.question: with multiple plugins, are params/result seen by AgentGuard original, pre-rewrite, or final values
questions.evidence_ref: REVISED with fixed runId: before-chain handlers see ORIGINAL params; the real execute receives adjusted params (recordAdjustedParamsForToolCall); the after event observably carries adjusted params through the real consumeAdjustedParamsForToolCall channel when (runId, toolCallId) match, falling back to startArgs otherwise. Still partial because the after-event emission itself is simulated and the key requires matching runId — a host path that emits without runId silently degrades to startArgs

questions.question: can other plugins still rewrite params after approval and before execution
questions.evidence_ref: param rewrites happen only inside the single awaited before_tool_call chain that also carries requireApproval; there is no second rewrite phase between approval release and execute in the pinned host path. Live approval-lifecycle timing was not exercised

questions.question: toolCallId reuse across retries
questions.evidence_ref: /tools/invoke derives toolCallId from the caller idempotencyKey (same key -> same id; no key -> fresh timestamp id); the agent loop assigns per-item ids, so an LLM-level retry is a new item with a new id. A live retry scenario was not exercised

c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q03/Q04: identical host-supplied toolCallId observed across before/execute/after in every scenario, including under param rewrite
Q08: the real wrapper awaits the full before chain before the real execute; observed ordering confirms happens-before

truthy success passthrough and bounded string error semantics are proven, but falsy successful results emit neither result nor error (Q5) and error-path emission conditions rely on simulated emission (Q6); the terminal classifier cannot rely on field presence

zero-invocation on block:true is proven, but whether the real host emits after_tool_call for blocked items could only be simulated; the observer is not exported and no live evidence exists. The safe implementation rule (no terminal facts for blocked gate states) holds regardless

c2_gate_criteria.criterion: multi-plugin rewrites do not break security-critical identity
c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q12 (fixed): toolCallId identity is host-supplied and untouched by param merges; adjusted params flow through the real record/consume channel to execution and to the after event; identity stayed stable under rewrite
